rule_text: Independent validation requires a clean holdout dataset not used in model development.
Validation data must not have been used for Stage 27C/36A model fitting.
Validation data must not have been used for external pretraining.
Validation data must not have influenced model/feature/threshold selection.
The candidate, pathology target, and expected direction must be frozen before validation.
A positive validation readout requires the observed direction to match the frozen hypothesis.
Negative and null results must be reported rather than silently filtered.
Predictive or association replication does not imply causal mechanism.
Causal language requires direct perturbational evidence with prespecified outcomes.
Therapeutic claims are prohibited without disease-modifying experimental evidence.
